entities.name: San Giovanni Battista dei Cavalieri di Rodi

entities.summary: San Giovanni Battista dei Cavalieri di Rodi is a church in Rome, on piazza del Grillo in the Monti district. Its full title is the Palatine Chapel of Saint John the Baptist of the Knights of Rhodes.
